headline: Payroll Specialist
summary: Payroll specialist with three years at a shipping and a trading company in Zamboanga City. I run semi-monthly payroll for up to 300 employees, compute SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions and withholding tax, and work with HR on new hires, leaves and final pay. I am careful with deadlines and with employee questions.
skills: Government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG) and withholding tax
HR support: onboarding, leave records and employee files

experience.title: Payroll Specialist
bullets: Run semi-monthly payroll for about 300 crew and office staff, including sea allowances and overtime.
Compute and remit SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions and prepare the annual tax certificates.
Post payroll journal entries and reconcile the payroll bank account every cutoff.
Coordinate with HR on new hires, separations and leave balances so the first and last pays are right.

experience.title: Payroll and HR Assistant
bullets: Encoded biometric time records and leave forms for 80 employees each cutoff.
Kept the 201 files of employees complete and helped prepare new-hire requirements.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Financial Management
